problems.text: kmctl's package (`pyproject.toml`, `src/kmctl/`, its tests) sits at the repository root, so the root is both the workspace and a package, unlike `packages/kmaudit` and the operator's uv-monorepo layout

Every install line and install hint names the root as kmctl's source (docs, `README.md`, the hook hints, `HOOK_INSTALL`, the release notes template, the starter justfile, `action.yml`), so each breaks once the package moves

kmctl's code finds repository files by the root layout: the `parents[2]` fallbacks to `apm/` in `src/kmctl/plugin.py`, `src/kmctl/antigravity.py` and `src/kmctl/opencode.py`, and `src/kmctl/pin.py`'s uvx source with no subdirectory

The release tooling assumes a root project: both release workflows run a bare `uv build`, `scripts/check_wheel.py` defaults to the root `pyproject.toml`, and `scripts/release.py`'s install pattern would drop a `#subdirectory=` fragment
The knowledge bundle and the repo's own rules cite the old paths: `.okf/` `sources[].resource`, the summary, overview and manifesto, docs pages, and the `paths:` globs of local `.claude/rules/`

goals.text: The repository has the uv-monorepo shape (a workspace root that installs nothing, `packages/kmctl` and `packages/kmaudit` each a full package, one root `uv.lock`), and `uv run pytest` at the root still runs every test
Users install kmctl from post-move tags through `#subdirectory=packages/kmctl`, and projects pinned to v0.12.1 or older keep running their pin
The release workflows keep building, checking and publishing kmctl from its new folder until `release-per-package` reworks them
The knowledge bundle and rules describe the tree as it now is, and an ADR records the move

outcomes.change: The root is a workspace root that installs nothing, and kmctl builds from packages/kmctl
outcomes.checked_by: `uv sync` then `uv run kmctl --version` at the root prints `apm/apm.yml`'s version; `uv build --package kmctl` (wheel built from the sdist) and `uv build --wheel --package kmctl` both give a wheel at that version with `_skills`, `_agents` and `_rules` that `scripts/check_wheel.py` and `scripts/smoke_wheel.py` accept; `tests/scripts/test_release.py` and `tests/scripts/test_check_wheel.py` read `packages/kmctl/pyproject.toml`

outcomes.change: kmctl's tests live in packages/kmctl/tests, and repo-level tests stay in tests/
outcomes.checked_by: `uv run pytest --collect-only` at the root selects 1407 tests (888 under `packages/kmctl/tests`, 276 under `tests/`, the rest under `packages/kmaudit/tests`), and `uv run pytest` passes

outcomes.change: kmctl's source-tree fallbacks find apm/ at the repository root from the new folder
outcomes.checked_by: the existing skills, agents and rules tests pass against the editable install, where `_skills`, `_agents` and `_rules` do not exist

outcomes.change: The pin hand-off adds the subdirectory only for refs newer than v0.12.1
outcomes.checked_by: tests that a pin at v0.12.1 hands off to `git+https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl@COMMIT` and a pin at a newer tag to `...@COMMIT#subdirectory=packages/kmctl`, for the command and the not-installed notice alike

outcomes.change: Every install line, hint and the action install from packages/kmctl
outcomes.checked_by: `scripts/release.py set` keeps the `#subdirectory=packages/kmctl` fragment on every line it pins; the starter renders `kmctl_src` with the fragment for a newer `kmctl_ref` and without it for v0.12.1; `tests/test_starter.py -m integration` bootstraps from a `file://` clone; the `knowledge` CI job (`uses: ./`) passes

outcomes.change: The release workflows build and check kmctl from packages/kmctl
outcomes.checked_by: `tests/scripts/test_workflows.py` pins `uv build --package kmctl` and the check_wheel pyproject path in both workflows; a Release dry run on the branch passes the build and smoke-test job

outcomes.change: The knowledge bundle, docs and local rules cite the moved paths, and a new ADR records the move
outcomes.checked_by: `kmctl review due` reports no "source not resolved" notice; `kmctl check` and the strict okf-validate hook pass; historical records (`.okf/log.md`, `.okf/prototypes/`, eval results) keep their text
